[NCBK.2.4] **Reserved but not emitted** (handle the `default` case — adding a
producer later is ABI-additive):

| Kind | Note |
|---|---|
| `DS_EV_FACT_MODIFY`       | an upsert surfaces as a `FACT_ASSERT` followed by a `FACT_RETRACT` ([NFCT.5.1]), not a modify |
| `DS_EV_ACTION_CACHE_GET`  | a `cached()` read is a pure internal engine read ([LSTO.4.7.1] / [RARC.5.7.9]); it dispatches no callback, so no action event is emitted |
| `DS_EV_TIMER_FIRED` (20) | a cooldown-gated rule's later firing is seen through its ordinary firing events, joined to its `DS_EV_TIMER_ARMED` by `timetag` ([NCBK.2.12]); the value is never reissued ([STYL.2.8.7]) |

**Enum values 10, 11, 13, 14 and 17 are permanently vacant**, as
`proto/stream_event_kind.proto#StreamEventKind` reserves them, and none is ever
reissued: recorded streams in the wild carry them, so an undocumented hole is
safer than a recycled meaning. 10 held `DS_EV_ACTION_RECORD`, 11
`DS_EV_ACTION_ALERT`, 13 and 14 the
peer-connect pair, and 17 the DIFFERENTIAL backend's divergence event
([STYL.2.8.7]).
